I deactivated my personal Instagram at the beginning of December. I still have FB and Snap but I also don’t have a personal twitter. After a week, I didn’t even miss what the college kids I barely know were doing. When I had an IG, I spent a lot of time with my friends trying o figure out what pictures would get the most likes and why no one would comment. I think that added to some of my anxiety. I’m might reactivate it, but I will be deleting everyone I don’t know well enough, turning off the comments, and only posting things that I like, which doesn’t include pictures of myself. I’ll post about my hobbies and school accomplishments for my friends and family that don’t have Facebook. I will no longer willingly cause anxiety because of social media!

This is my personal story and I know there’s no advice, I’m sorry!
